name: regex

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2026.11.24"

package:
  name: regex
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/r/regex/regex-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 07f222de81cdcfd39eef8671e92d14f50f61f1666f756659b0e649cf700b1b10

build:
  number: 0
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
  host:
    - python
    - setuptools >77.0.3
    - pip
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - regex
      pip_check: true

about:
  summary: Alternative regular expression module, to replace re.
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  homepage: https://github.com/mrabarnett/mrab-regex

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - kwilcox
    - ocefpaf
    - xhochy
